name: Nebraska
agency: Nebraska Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS)

period.description: Your share of cost is a monthly amount; each month is decided on its own.

submission.description: DHHS mails you a share of cost form each month for your providers to fill out and sign. The provider who gives the care that meets your share of cost sends in the form.

notes: Any medically needed service or supply counts, even if Medicaid would not cover it.
If you do not meet your share of cost in a month, Medicaid pays no bills for that month.
To be considered for Medically Needy, say so in the comments section of your Medicaid application.
